summary: Phase 2 verification (unified Materials + Reorder Center + Ink calibration propagation). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend: Materials CRUD, +/- stock, is_default replacement, Reorder Center email send (200 OK), Ink Estimator calibration with sibling toast all pass.

issues: Radix warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking a11y warning — add DialogDescription for screen readers.

backend.ink_calibrate_propagation: POST /api/ink/calibrate on Roland VersaCAMM VP-540i (largeformat): siblings_updated>0, other Roland LF machines updated to same new_ml_per_sqft_full, Roland directprint & Mimaki untouched. PASS
backend.materials_list_computed_fields: finish_cost / retail_price / selling_price / low_stock / below_cost all present. PASS
backend.materials_is_default_replacement: Creating second material with is_default=true in same category unsets previous default. PASS
backend.reorder_grouping_and_suggested_qty: Groups by supplier_email; suggested_qty=target-stock. Verified 20-1=19. PASS

frontend.materials_page: Loads with 4 seeded rows, 3 default badges, low-stock stock values shown in red (2 of 4).
frontend.materials_create: Dialog opens, name/cost/supplier/stock/reorder/module chip/is_default all fillable. Save → row appears (rows: 4→5). New material appears in listing.
frontend.is_default_replacement_UI: Setting is_default on new sheet material unset previous default (Gloss Text lost DEFAULT badge; 'Defaults set' KPI dropped 3→2). Behavior consistent with backend.
frontend.reorder_center: 2 supplier cards (SignSupply Co., RollMedia Ltd.), 2 low-stock items; Order Qty prefilled to 42 (50-8) and 10 (12-2).

frontend.ink_estimator_calibration_toast: Toast: 'Learned! Roland VersaCAMM VP-540i → 9.2 ml/ft² · 2 samples · applied to 2 sibling machine(s)' — sibling wording present. PASS

action_items: OPTIONAL: Suppress Radix Dialog a11y warning by adding <DialogDescription> to material-dialog and reorder-compose-dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py compute_material writes computed fields into the input dict via m.update — fine, but the same dict is later scrubbed in-place for non-admins (list_materials). Works, but consider returning a fresh dict to avoid mutation surprises.
reorder_email endpoint stamps materials.reordered_at only after successful send but does NOT decrement stock or link to an incoming PO — likely intentional (email is a suggestion), worth documenting.

_propagate_ink_calibration matches sibling machines by regex on brand + same category. Two Roland VersaCAMM series (RE-640, XR-640, VP-540i) all categorized as 'largeformat' — propagates as expected. Note: it will also propagate across any Roland LF ink chemistry variants if added later; not a bug now but flag if UV/eco-solvent Roland LF ever coexist.
Frontend Materials.js: uses window.confirm for delete rather than shadcn AlertDialog — inconsistent with rest of app.
seed_data_creation: Test materials created and cleaned up via pytest fixtures and UI test flow. Final state matches initial state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 (Materials + Reorder + Ink propagation) fully verified. Note: running the ink calibration test bumps ink_samples on Roland VP-540i and applies new_val to Roland RE-640 & XR-640; if further iterations depend on original seeded ink values, re-seed or reset the machines collection.
